## Goal
- Deploy the current GitHub `main` commit to `ivx-holdings-platform` and verify exact GitHub/Render/live `/health` SHA parity end to end.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do not create another Render service or repository.
- Do not deploy old code or use “Deploy previous commit.”
- Do not guess deployment causes or change configuration without evidence.
- Do not expose, retrieve, or return secret values.
- Completion requires Render `Live`, `https://api.ivxholding.com/health` HTTP `200`, and matching GitHub/Render/live commit SHA.

## Progress
### Done
- Expo Reel pagination consolidation:
  - Added `fetchVideoFeedPage(limit, cursor)` in `expo/lib/video-feed.ts`.
  - Added `expo/hooks/useReelsFeed.ts` using `useInfiniteQuery`, backend cursors, `ivxQueryKeys.reels('all')`, retry policy, and media-ID deduplication.
  - Migrated `expo/app/videos.tsx` to `useReelsFeed()`.
- Verified Render production source root is repository root:
  - Root `Dockerfile`, `package.json`, `bun.lock`, `server.ts`, and `render.yaml`.
  - No evidence supports `backend/`, `server/`, `api/`, or `apps/api/` as Render root directories.
- Verified `render.yaml`:
  - Service `ivx-holdings-platform`; repository `ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest`; branch `main`.
  - `runtime: docker`, `dockerfilePath: ./Dockerfile`, `dockerContext: .`.
  - Runtime command: `node /app/node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs /app/server.ts`.
  - `healthCheckPath: /health`, `autoDeployTrigger: commit`, domain `api.ivxholding.com`.
- Verified `server.ts` production listener honors `PORT` and `HOST`, with defaults `3000` and `0.0.0.0`.
- Verified `backend/hono.ts` registers unauthenticated `GET /health` and emits commit/boot metadata.
- Verified production capabilities safely:
  - AI gateway `vercel_ai_gateway`, model `openai/gpt-4o`, credential valid.
  - Production GitHub: `canReadRepo: true`, `canPush: true`.
  - Production Render: `canDeploy: true`.
  - Variable presence: `16/16` present.
- Repaired prior TypeScript errors in `backend/api/ivx-developer-deploy-control.ts`:
  - Safe `parsed.action_link` handling.
  - Corrected `../services/ivx-deploy-certification-gate` import.
  - Typed `gateError` as `unknown`.
  - Replaced incompatible optional log-entry `null` values with `undefined`.
- Verified passwordless owner recovery and protected deployment authorization:
  - `POST /api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` returns a password-preserving magic-link session.
  - Authorized owner session can access deployment controls.
- Obtained Render workspace owner safely from authorized API:
  - `ownerId`: `tea-d7plj9beo5us73ch3ukg`.
  - Workspace: `My Workspace`, type `team`.
- Confirmed Render image builds complete before application startup failures.
- Repaired the confirmed SES source truncation:
  - Restored `backend/services/ivx-ses-email.ts` as plain TypeScript source.
  - GitHub commit: `5fc3152e73b1c9c82754cf3490844e3336c7ec8c` (`Fix SES service source syntax for Render startup`).
  - Local validation passed: `bunx tsx --eval "import('./backend/services/ivx-ses-email.ts').then(() => console.log('ses-module-parse=ok'))"`.
- Diagnosed subsequent Render startup failure from authorized RFC3339 Render logs:
  - Startup emitted `ReferenceError: aW1wb3J0IH...`, indicating a Base64 payload being treated as JavaScript/TypeScript source.
  - GitHub `backend/api/ivx-developer-deploy-control.ts` was Base64-encoded instead of plain source (`bytes: 222736`, `isBase64Payload: true`).
- Restored `backend/api/ivx-developer-deploy-control.ts` as plain TypeScript source:
  - GitHub commit: `d8091efba2caf04a43d14402d6f4dd365a49d47e`.
  - Local parse passed: `deploy-control-parse=ok`.
- Performed a recursive GitHub scan of `647` `backend/**/*.ts` blobs and found three additional Base64-encoded source files:
  - `backend/api/ivx-payment-api.ts`
  - `backend/services/ivx-payment-service.ts`
  - `backend/ivx-payment-infrastructure.test.ts`
- Restored all three payment files as plain TypeScript source:
  - GitHub commit: `4652a6930a99142b339e43872c5221a04efeab21` (`Restore payment modules as plain TypeScript source`).
  - Payment module parsing passed: `payment-modules-parse=ok`.
  - `bun test backend/ivx-payment-infrastructure.test.ts` passed.
- Verified all known repaired files are currently plain TypeScript on GitHub `main`:
  - `backend/services/ivx-ses-email.ts`
  - `backend/api/ivx-developer-deploy-control.ts`
  - `backend/api/ivx-payment-api.ts`
  - `backend/services/ivx-payment-service.ts`
  - `backend/ivx-payment-infrastructure.test.ts`
- Local startup reached the Hono listener before timeout:
  - `timeout 25s node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs server.ts`
  - Logged `[IVX Server] Hono API server online { host: '0.0.0.0', port: 3000, family: 'IPv4' }`.

### In Progress
- Render auto-deployment sequence for the repaired commits:
  - `dep-d9hs7ur3huhc738vgt50` for `d8091efba2caf04a43d14402d6f4dd365a49d47e` was `update_in_progress` at the latest poll.
  - `dep-d9hs88oo57mc738opcn0` for current GitHub `main` `4652a6930a99142b339e43872c5221a04efeab21` was `queued` at the latest poll.
- Monitor Render until the deployment for `4652a6930a99142b339e43872c5221a04efeab21` reaches `live` or `update_failed`.
- Verify production `/health` SHA parity only after Render promotes the current commit.

### Blocked
- End-to-end verification is incomplete because the latest current-main deployment was still queued at the latest check.
- Earlier repaired SES deployments failed before the Base64-encoded deploy-control module was restored:
  - `dep-d9hs6b715fvs73c4csa0`: `update_failed`.
  - `dep-d9hs6cb3huhc738vfnb0`: `update_failed`.
  - `dep-d9hs750o57mc738oog60`: `update_failed`.
  - All targeted `5fc3152e73b1c9c82754cf3490844e3336c7ec8c`.
- Production was still serving stale commit `905ebdc996c0310528d417d8a387f1111023eeb1` when last checked.
- Docker is unavailable locally: `docker=MISSING`.
- `bun run build` fails: `error: Script not found "build"`.
- Remaining `bunx tsc --noEmit` errors include:
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(82,39): error TS2339: Property 'totalDistributions' does not exist on type 'AccountSummary'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(84,21): error TS2339: Property 'lastActivityDate' does not exist on type 'AccountSummary'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(85,38): error TS2339: Property 'lastActivityDate' does not exist on type 'AccountSummary'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(114,23): error TS2339: Property 'id' does not exist on type 'LedgerEntry'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts(7712,9): error TS2322: Type '"ivx_qa_only_runtime"' is not assignable to type '"chatgpt" | "ivx_daily_improvement" | "ivx_self_developer_runtime" | "ivx_readonly_inspection_runtime" | undefined'.`
  - `backend/hono.ts(5057,28): error TS2554: Expected 2 arguments, but got 1.`

## Key Decisions
- Treat repository root as the only valid Render source root.
- Keep Render paths unchanged:
  - Root Directory: blank.
  - Dockerfile Path: `./Dockerfile`.
  - Docker Build Context: `.`.
- Use `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action`, not `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy`.
- Use the existing passwordless owner-recovery route for authorized deployment controls.
- Treat Render Logs API evidence as authoritative for deployment failures.
- Do not alter Render configuration:
  - Docker image builds succeeded.
  - Failures were application startup transformations/evaluations caused by source blobs committed as Base64 rather than plain TypeScript.
- Restore only evidence-confirmed corrupted files and validate each locally before committing.
- Do not claim completion until Render is `Live` and `/health` returns the exact current GitHub `main` commit.

## Next Steps
1. Poll Render deployments for `dep-d9hs7ur3huhc738vgt50` and `dep-d9hs88oo57mc738opcn0`.
2. If `d8091efba2caf04a43d14402d6f4dd365a49d47e` fails, retrieve its RFC3339-filtered Render application logs and identify the next exact runtime failure.
3. Wait for or trigger only the current-main deployment for `4652a6930a99142b339e43872c5221a04efeab21`; do not deploy an older commit.
4. When Render reports `live`, request `GET https://api.ivxholding.com/health`.
5. Verify HTTP `200`, `status: "healthy"`, and `commit === "4652a6930a99142b339e43872c5221a04efeab21"`.
6. Confirm the Render live deployment commit is the same SHA as GitHub `main`.
7. Resolve remaining repository TypeScript errors and perform Docker-capable container validation separately.
